page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is a GPU-accelerated instance type belonging to the ecs.gn5i family. It features an x86_64 architecture with 2 dedicated physical CPU cores and 2 vCPUs, operating with 1.0 thread per core. The instance is equipped with 8.0 GB of system memory, providing 4.0 GB of RAM per core.

Acceleration is provided by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via network-attached block storage. Network connectivity is configured with a baseline bandwidth of 1 Gbps. The virtualization layer is managed by the KVM hypervisor.

This instance represents an entry-level GPU configuration. The combination of a low vCPU count, 8.0 GB of system memory, and an older-generation NVIDIA P4 GPU makes it suitable for lightweight GPU workloads rather than heavy training tasks. Appropriate workloads include small-scale inference, video transcoding, and basic graphics rendering. The lack of local storage and low baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps are key constraints to consider when designing deployments.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.gn5i-c2g1.large is an entry-level GPU-accelerated instance within the ecs.gn5i family. Built on the x86_64 architecture and managed via the KVM hypervisor, it features 2 dedicated physical CPU cores (2 vCPUs) with no hyperthreading, paired with 8.0 GB of system memory. Graphics and compute acceleration are handled by a single NVIDIA P4 GPU with 8 GB of VRAM. The instance does not include local storage, relying entirely on network-attached storage, and provides a baseline network bandwidth of 1 Gbps. Given its modest resource allocation, this instance is designed for lightweight GPU-accelerated tasks such as small-scale inference, video transcoding, and basic graphics processing. It offers a cost-efficient entry point for GPU compute without the overhead of larger multi-GPU configurations, though it is constrained by its low network throughput and lack of local disk space.
